record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.context_brief: Injectivity of z ↦ L^{APP}_z(X,Y) on large classes.
record.original_question: Fix infinite-dimensional Banach spaces X and Y. Find large collections Z of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals such that (i) Z contains every Lorentz-type ideal d_{r,w}(N0), and (ii) the map z(N0) ↦ L^{APP}_z(X,Y) is one-to-one on Z.

evidence.quote:
Problem 20. Fix any pair of infinite-dimensional Banach spaces X and Y .
Find large sets Z of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals that have
the following properties:
(1) Z contains all dr,w(N0).
(2) The restriction of the map z(N0) → LAPP
z (X, Y ) to Z is one-to-one.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{N}_0 = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$. A quasi-Banach sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is a linear subspace of the space of scalar sequences indexed by $\mathbb{N}_0$ which is equipped with a complete quasi-norm $\|\cdot\|_{z}$ such that whenever $|a_n| \le |b_n|$ for all $n$ and $(b_n) \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$, then $(a_n) \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|(a_n)\|_z \le \|(b_n)\|_z$. Such an ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is called shift-monotone if for every $(a_n) \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ the shifted sequence $(a_{n+1})_n$ also belongs to $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with no greater quasi-norm.

For parameters $0 < r < \infty$ and $0 < w \le \infty$, the Lorentz-type sequence ideal $d_{r,w}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ consists of those sequences $(a_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ whose non-increasing rearrangement $(a_n^*)$ satisfies
\[
\|(a_n)\|_{d_{r,w}} = \Bigl(\sum_{n=0}^{\infty} (n+1)^{w/r-1}(a_n^*)^w\Bigr)^{1/w} < \infty \quad (w<\infty),
\]
with the usual modification for $w = \infty$.

For a bounded linear operator $T: X \to Y$ between Banach spaces, let $a_n(T)$ denote the $n$-th approximation number, i.e.\ the distance in operator norm from $T$ to the operators of rank at most $n$. Given a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal $z(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and Banach spaces $X,Y$, define
\[
\mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{z}(X,Y) = \{\, T \in \mathcal{L}(X,Y) : (a_n(T))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0} \in z(\mathbb{N}_0)\,\}.
\]

Problem. Fix arbitrary infinite-dimensional Banach spaces $X$ and $Y$. Exhibit large collections $\mathcal{Z}$ of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals such that:
(i) $d_{r,w}(\mathbb{N}_0) \in \mathcal{Z}$ for every admissible pair $(r,w)$;
(ii) the assignment $z(\mathbb{N}_0) \mapsto \mathfrak{L}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{z}(X,Y)$ is injective on $\mathcal{Z}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem in a survey-style listing of open problems by A. Pietsch on traces on operator ideals defined over all Banach spaces (zbMATH 7709580). No subsequent work resolving this specific injectivity problem was located.
